nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API endpoint that regenerates an existing API key, rotating the secret while preserving permissions and audit history.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: POST handler that authenticates the admin caller, rate-limits the request, and regenerates the specified API key in storage.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API endpoint that toggles the enabled/disabled state of an API key without revoking it.

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: PATCH handler that authenticates and rate-limits then flips an API key's active flag, returning the updated state.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API endpoint for a single API key supporting GET (details and usage analytics) and PATCH (regenerate or toggle via action verbs).

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: GET handler returning a single API key with redacted secrets and aggregated usage metrics (popular endpoints, daily counts).

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: PATCH handler that dispatches to regenerate or toggle sub-actions based on the request body verb.

nodes.name: handleRegenerate
nodes.summary: Internal helper that performs the key rotation, persists the new hash, and returns the freshly minted plaintext key once.

nodes.name: handleToggle
nodes.summary: Internal helper that flips an API key's active status and audits the change.

nodes.name: getPopularEndpoints
nodes.summary: Aggregates the most-called endpoints for a given API key from usage logs.

nodes.name: getDailyUsage
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-day API call counts for the given key over a recent window.

nodes.summary: POST handler that validates input and creates a new API key, returning the plaintext value once for the operator to capture.

nodes.name: PUT
nodes.summary: PUT handler that updates mutable fields of an existing API key (name, permissions, expiry) with validation.

nodes.name: DELETE
nodes.summary: DELETE handler that revokes and removes an API key after auth and confirmation checks.
